problem:
Title: Continuous Mapping from Compact Space to Hausdorff Space Preserves Local Connectedness

Let $T_1 = \struct {S_1, \tau_1}$ be a [[Definition:Compact Topological Space|compact topological space]].

Let $T_2 = \struct {S_2, \tau_2}$ be a [[Definition:Hausdorff Space|$T_2$ (Hausdorff) space]].

Let $f: T_1 \to T_2$ be a [[Definition:Everywhere Continuous Mapping (Topology)|continuous mapping]].

Let $T_1$ be [[Definition:Locally Connected Space|locally connected]].

Then $T_2$ is also [[Definition:Locally Connected Space|locally connected]].
